item.title: 科研论文每日速递 | 2026-09-15 | 10 篇
item.description:
本期收录 10 篇论文。

  1. When Ground-Truth Fidelity Matters: An Orchestrated UAS Framework for Wheat Streak Mosaic Virus Detection Using Vision Transformers and Machine Learning (67/100)
  2. CL4D: Contrastive Language-4D Pretraining for Vision-Language Reasoning in Dynamic Scenes — CL4D：面向动态场景视觉语言推理的对比语言-4D预训练 (65/100)
  3. RoofSeg: An edge-aware transformer-based network for end-to-end roof plane segmentation — RoofSeg：一种用于端到端屋顶平面分割的边缘感知Transformer网络 (62/100)
  4. GBOV-trained Gaussian process models for Sentinel-3 SYN vegetation traits with decomposed uncertainty quantification — 基于GBOV训练的高斯过程模型用于Sentinel-3 SYN植被性状反演及分解不确定性量化 (60/100)
  5. AgentGrad: Intervention-guided Prompt Optimization for Multi Agent Systems — AgentGrad：用于多智能体系统的干预引导提示优化 (60/100)
  6. ARNAI: Artifact Removal Network based on Autoencoding and Inpainting for Robust Spinal Image Segmentation and Measurement — ARNAI：基于自编码和修复的伪影去除网络用于鲁棒的脊柱图像分割与测量 (60/100)
  7. From Open Standards to Openly Governed: Standards-Setting Organizations as Stewards of Openness amid Platformization and Digital Sovereignty — 从开放标准到开放治理：平台化与数字主权背景下的标准制定组织作为开放性管理者 (60/100)
  8. GenONet: A Generative operator Network for High-Resolution Precipitation Nowcasting — GenONet：用于高分辨率降水临近预报的生成算子网络 (60/100)
  9. Electronic Navigational Chart Change Classification — 电子海图变化分类 (60/100)
  10. Earth-Agent-Pro: Towards Real-World Full-Chain Earth Observation with Agents (55/100)
